assessment: The nearest right lantern now has thinner metal framing, connected open eight-petal tracery, small quatrefoil friezes and an open supported underside. It improves the former coarse timber/isolated-flower/black-cone construction while preserving the original paper panels, light, anchor and envelope.
remaining: Narrow metal edges and lower support still clip to bright white.
Paper grain has a regular stripe pattern.
Motifs and hanging ornaments remain interpreted; the wider night scene still differs significantly from the reference.
